citation: NEC-5 printouts captured as End-User Reports; NEC-5 is (c) LLNL, LLNL-CODE-746721. The binary is user-licensed and never distributed. Decks were emitted by EZNEC Pro/2+ v7.0.4 driving NEC5CL_x13.exe (antennaknobs capture sessions, momwire#390/#456); printouts are the Windows engine’s own, byte-verbatim including CRLF line endings.
source: antennaknobs scratch/eznec-capture/ (capture ids preserved); scored matrix: antennaknobs docs/status/2026-08-20-eznec-nec5-scored-matrix.md
normalizations: byte-compare after: CRLF->LF; drop FILL=/RUN TIME timing lines; normalize -0.00 vs 0.00 signed zero in pattern TILT columns; drop every SOMMPD.NEX cache block, each of which is ONE BLANK LINE followed by a run of cache lines (the blank is part of the block; dropping it leaves the finite-ground ANTENNA ENVIRONMENT block the same heading/blank/name shape FREE SPACE and PERFECT GROUND already have). Four block forms are observed across these captures and #504 U3's nineteen new printouts and #504 U4's two add no fifth, and neither do momwire#511's 0036/0038, which are GN -1 free space and carry no block of any form: STALE, ' GMPINO: EPSC from file = <epsc>' + '              should be  <epsc>' + ' Will compute Sommerfeld-ground tables' (0003-0009, 0011, 0021, 0023, 0025, 0026, 0029, 0030, 0033, 0047, 0048, and the five bare-GD captures 0015/0020/0031/0045/0046); VALID, 'Sommerfeld integral tables read:' + 'Potentials: <numbers>' + 'E, H: <numbers>' (0000, 0001, 0002, 0022, 0034); ABSENT, ' GMPINO: Unable to open file SOMMPD.NEX' (blank-padded to 70 columns) + ' Will compute Sommerfeld-ground tables' (measured on the linux oracle 2026-08-20, no capture); and the POSTAMBLE, printed between the EN echo and RUN TIME, 'Sommerfeld integral tables written in previous run:' + 'Potentials: <numbers>' + 'E and H: <numbers>' (0000, 0001, 0002, 0011, 0022, 0030, 0033, 0034, 0047, 0048). The number list after each label is what varies and it may be EMPTY on any of them - 0000/0001/0002 write a bare 'Potentials:' beside a filled 'E, H: 11 12 13 14 15 21 23', and 0011/0030/0033/0034 write a bare 'E and H:' beside a filled 'Potentials:' - so a cache line is recognised by the LABEL it opens with and never by a whole line. The POSTAMBLE is a report about the FILE and not about the mode, which is a correction #504 U3's captures forced: the eight-printout corpus this key was first written against carried it on its four GN 0 captures and on none of its four bare-GD ones, and 0000/0001/0002 are bare-GD runs that carry it. What IS a statement about the mode is the MATRIX TIMING cell (0045's FILL= 0.000 SEC. against 0047's 0.094): a GD run announces 'Will compute Sommerfeld-ground tables' off the cache check and then computes none. The seam never reads and never writes SOMMPD.NEX, so it emits none of these blocks.
withheld_printouts: FIVE of the seven decks in the 2026-08-17 frequency-stepping dipole session ship no printout, and the reason is the session rather than the decks: 0037's OUT is EMPTY and 0042 has none at all; 0039 and 0041 carry a one- and a forty-two-line file whose last line is ' ***** NEC ERROR - MOMWIRE REFUSES THIS DECK...', which is an early prototype of THIS seam answering in place of NEC5CL rather than the engine; and 0040 stops mid-printout at 40 lines. Nothing in those five is an engine printout, so there is nothing to land and no follow-up left on them. 0036 and 0038 ARE complete 144-line engine printouts carrying their own decks' stamps, and momwire#511 landed them: #504 U3 held them back so the session kept ONE treatment, which cost the corpus two free-space XQ gates for a tidiness this key can state in a sentence instead. The remaining five keep the liveness gate tests/test_eznec_serve.py::test_the_ungated_rung_one_captures_still_serve.
